result.description: A fictional ultrawide display built for panoramic dashboards, split-screen editing, and long-form productivity. The Orbit X1 combines a 34-inch curved IPS panel with a 3440 x 1440 resolution, 100 Hz refresh rate, and USB-C display input for streamlined workstation setups. Its emphasis is on desk ergonomics and broad visual workspace rather than graphics acceleration or local storage. The monitor includes adjustable height and tilt support, low-blue-light viewing modes, and a matte anti-glare finish for office and creative environments.
